description: This file defines version management functions and variables for the Mattermost project, including version list, current version, and functions to handle version comparisons and retrievals.

methods.name: SplitVersion
methods.description: Splits a version string into major, minor, and patch integers.

methods.name: GetPreviousVersion
methods.description: Returns the previous version in the list based on the current version.

methods.name: IsCurrentVersion
methods.description: Checks if a given version matches the current version.

methods.name: IsPreviousVersionsSupported
methods.description: Determines if a given version is supported based on the list of supported versions.
